title: BLS CPI/OEWS source rights and dated-series semantics
summary: Primary BLS copyright page says BLS-authored publications public domain except previously copyrighted photos/illustrations. Numeric CPI/OEWS candidates support copy/cache/commercial/derivative use under that statement; cite source and revision. CPI flatfile docs define series_id/year/period/value/footnotes and series metadata; seasonality,population,base and annualM13 remain distinct. CUUR0000SA0 is a candidate requiring exact metadata verification. OEWS page currentMay2025 with national/state/metro/industryTXT/XLSX and historical files; SOC/area/NAICS vintage,wage units and suppression matter. No observation sample executed. Employees1985–2002 lacks country/currency, so no automatic US deflation or wage benchmark.
